mechanism: Systematic vol-targeting and risk-parity-style funds size positions as Target Volatility / Realized Volatility: when short-term realized vol rises above the medium-term baseline, allowable gross exposure mechanically falls and they must sell/de-risk regardless of view. Because that selling itself adds to realized volatility, the process is self-reinforcing over multiple days — a vol shock keeps being amplified by the very funds whose mandate is to reduce risk in response to it. The forced, non-discretionary counterparty is this pool of vol-targeting/risk-parity capital (aggregate AUM estimated in the hundreds of billions to low trillions across markets); they cannot wait for the move to look 'done' before trimming, so price in the direction of the initiating shock tends to extend for several sessions until the vol term structure normalizes and they re-lever.
counterparty: Systematic vol-targeting / risk-parity-style funds forced to cut gross exposure mechanically as short-horizon realized vol rises above the medium-horizon baseline (position size = target vol / realized vol); they must transact regardless of view, and their own deleveraging further raises realized vol, which is the self-reinforcing forcing function.
prediction: When the annualized 1-month realized-vol minus 3-month realized-vol spread on BTC/ETH is sustained above +3 percentage points for two consecutive weeks (the deleveraging regime), price will continue drifting in the direction of the prior 5-day (120h) return over the following ~3-5 days (120 1h bars) at a net-of-cost win rate above fee_math.p_star for the registered tp_bps, because vol-targeting deleveraging is self-reinforcing rather than mean-reverting on that horizon.

signal_py:
"""vol_structure_termspread_delever signal: multi-day continuation triggered by a
sustained 1-month vs 3-month realized-vol term-structure inversion (vol-targeting
fund forced-deleveraging proxy). Closed bars only — all statistics are backward-
looking rolling windows on the bar's own close; no shift(-k), no future index use.
"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

RV_1MO_BARS = 720          # ~30 days of 1h bars
RV_3MO_BARS = 2160         # ~90 days of 1h bars
SUSTAIN_BARS = 336         # ~2 weeks of 1h bars — spread must hold above threshold
SPREAD_THRESHOLD_PP = 3.0  # percentage points, per sourced threshold
MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK = 120    # ~5 days of 1h bars, direction of the initiating move
ANNUALIZATION = np.sqrt(24 * 365) * 100.0


def signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    close = df["close"]
    ret = close.pct_change()

    rv_1mo = ret.rolling(RV_1MO_BARS).std() * ANNUALIZATION
    rv_3mo = ret.rolling(RV_3MO_BARS).std() * ANNUALIZATION
    spread = rv_1mo - rv_3mo

    sustained = (spread.rolling(SUSTAIN_BARS).min() > SPREAD_THRESHOLD_PP).fillna(False)

    momentum = close.pct_change(MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK)
    direction = np.sign(momentum).fillna(0)

    sig = pd.Series(0, index=df.index, dtype=int)
    sig[sustained] = direction[sustained].astype(int)
    return sig
